verdict_summary: ISS-0206 fix is sound and ready to release. RowFields-then-rowToDefinitionFromFields pattern correctly registers each errdefer immediately after its try, eliminating the unbuffered-partial-construction leak. Narrow ISS-0206 target suite passes 5/5 with no leaks. Definition-store regression suite passes 3/3. Build, all three linters, NFR benchmarks (5/5), and verify_test_env.py all green after environment remediation (COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME export + advisory-lock clearing). The aggregate-test runner shutdown hang observed on this branch is identical to the one reproduced on origin/main (Build Summary: 83/83 steps succeeded; 939/1003 tests passed (64 skipped) with one binary hung at shutdown) — pre-existing Zig 0.16 infra defect, not introduced by ISS-0206.

issues.description: ISS-0206 is registered as MAJOR in docs/issues/ISS-0206.json (severity field), but the user's request stated BLOCKER. The narrower fix scope (single function in src/definition/store.zig, internal errdefer correctness) supports MAJOR; the BLOCKER framing may have referred to the original symptom of leaking resources. The release decision notes this discrepancy without blocking.
issues.remediation: Edit docs/issues/ISS-0206.json severity field to BLOCKER or MAJOR consistently with how the user/board describes it. Out of scope for this release.

issues.description: Step 6 handoff was created by RELEASE-VALIDATOR instead of ORCH. The standard WF-03 pipeline has ORCH create step-N handoffs and dispatch them. This is a process deviation, not a code defect.
issues.remediation: Update handoff creation policy to allow agents to bootstrap missing step handoffs when upstream agents omit them, with a clear `from_agent: ORCH` attribution and a recorded audit-trail entry.
